title: Cartridge filters
description: Filter cartridges for dust collection systems — suitable for Plymovent, KEMPER, Camfil, TEKA and other manufacturers’ equipment.
paragraphs: We offer filter cartridges suitable for filtration equipment from various manufacturers, including Plymovent, KEMPER, Camfil, TEKA and others.

Cartridge filters are widely used in industrial processing equipment within dust collection systems. Cartridges are made from various materials such as cellulose, polyester, PES with ePTFE membrane, or antistatic media.

specs.label: Materials
specs.value: Cellulose, polyester, PES with ePTFE membrane, antistatic
